notes.title: Astor: Blade of the Monolith Patch 3!
notes.content:
[h3]Hello Warriors of Gliese![/h3]

We're excited to bring you another update for Astor: Blade of the Monolith! This patch includes a variety of improvements based on your feedback and our ongoing efforts to enhance gameplay and balance.

[h3]Gameplay Adjustments[/h3]

[list]
[*] [b]Weapon Balance:[/b] Balanced various weapons, with special attention to the Gauntlets and Hammer. Adjustments aim to improve effectiveness and ensure each weapon feels distinct and powerful.
[*] [b]Construct Companions Enhancement:[/b] Adjusted Construct Companions to hit harder and exhibit more aggressive behavior in combat.
[*] [b]Boss Balance Rework:[/b] Several bosses have been reworked to provide a more challenging experience, aligning their difficulty better with regular enemies.
[*] [b]Improved Block Responsiveness:[/b] The responsiveness of the block action has been enhanced, making parries more accurate and timing-dependent.
[*] [b]Boss Attack Fixes:[/b] Fixed issues where some boss attacks could be interrupted unexpectedly, causing behavioral inconsistencies.
[*] [b]Block Drop Construct Adjustments:[/b] Increased cooldown and adjusted damage values for the Block Drop construct. Now rewards skilled players with a 1.5x damage multiplier when used with a combo of 10 or higher.
[*] [b]Aerial Combat Adjustments:[/b] Melee enemies will no longer throw projectiles while the player is performing aerial attacks, eliminating unfair interruptions.
[/list]

[h3]New Content[/h3]
[list]
[*] [b]New Crystal Life Items:[/b] Added new crystal life items to the store:
[/list]
[olist]
[*] Healing Crystal
[*] Health Crystal Boost Lv 1, Lv 2, and Lv 3
[/olist]
[list]
[*] [b]New Awakening Tutorial:[/b] Added a reinforced tutorial for the Awakening mechanic to provide clearer guidance and understanding for players.
[/list]

[h3]Audio and Visual Enhancements[/h3]
[b]Combat Music Intensity:[/b] Adjusted the intensity of combat music to change more gradually based on the number of hits performed in combat, providing a smoother and more natural transition.
[b]Golem King Boss Audio:[/b] Improved audio for the Golem King boss encounter for a more immersive experience.
[b]Collision Improvements:[/b] Enhanced tree collision mechanics to improve realism and gameplay interactions.

[h3]Bug Fixes and Improvements[/h3]
[list]
[*] [b]Challenge and Replay Fixes:[/b] Addressed various bugs related to challenges and replay functionality.
[*] [b]Renamed map tab[/b] in adventure menu to collectables to better reflect the purpose of this section
[*] 
[/list]
We're committed to delivering the best experience possible in Astor: Blade of the Monolith. 

Your feedback continues to be invaluable to us, so please keep sharing your thoughts and experiences!

Thank you for your support and dedication to exploring the world of Gliese with us.

[h3]— The C2 Game Studio Team
[/h3]

notes.title: Astor: Blade of the Monolith Patch 1.1.0 is out!
notes.content:
[h2]Greetings, Warriors of Gliese![/h2]

[b]We are excited to bring you the second update for Astor: Blade of the Monolith![/b] Your feedback has been instrumental in helping us identify and fix issues, as well as improve the game. We hope you continue to share your thoughts with us as you explore the mysteries and dangers of Gliese.

[h2][b]Update 1.1.0 Patch Notes:[/b][/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44358956/228be910c3af6b1a2e860f07e1c573bd69a68c0a.png[/img]
[b]Community Feedback Implementation[/b]
[list]
[*] [b]Hammer Rune Ability: [/b]Adjusted the hammer's rune ability to be more effective and responsive, ensuring it hits enemies more reliably and faces their direction when activated.
[*] [b]Additional Controller Mapping Presets:[/b] Added 2 extra presets based on feedback.
[*] [b]Improved Drowning Mechanics:[/b] Falling into deep water no longer deals damage to the player, improving the drowning mechanic for a more seamless gameplay experience.
[*] [b]Enhanced Climbing Sequences:[/b] Improved climbing sequences, particularly in the Start Camp level, to provide smoother and more intuitive traversal mechanics.
[/list]
[b]Bug Fixes[/b]
[list]
[*] [b]Cinematic Loops:[/b] Fixed an issue where the final cinematic sequence from Kalios to Lyceum could get stuck in an indefinite loop.
[*] [b]Respawn Glitches:[/b] Resolved a rare bug where falling into water would cause the player to respawn on top of the water instead of on solid ground.
[*] [b]Character Behavior:[/b] Corrected an issue where Zan would walk out of cinematic scenes in Start Camp. Zan will now stay in place as intended. (He's not that shy anymore). 
[*] [b]Low Health Warning:[/b] Improved the low health status effect to alert players earlier, giving more time to react and heal.
[*] [b]Collectable Items:[/b] Fixed the collectable item counting in levels, which previously showed incorrect totals on the map.
[*] [b]Chapter Replay Fix:[/b] Addressed an issue in the replay chapter of "Inside the Monolith" during the fight against Haken, ensuring the encounter progresses smoothly.
[*][b]Fixed the bug with the achievement: Ultimate Life Form not triggering properly at all times. [/b](Players that already bought all the upgrades can unlock it by opening a store and waiting for a few seconds)
[/list]
We are continuously working on implementing your suggestions and addressing other reported bugs. Your support and feedback are invaluable to us, and we encourage you to keep sharing your experiences as you journey through Gliese. If you can, please leave us a review - it really helps let others know about the game! 

[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1989320/Astor_Blade_of_the_Monolith/#app_reviews_hash]You can leave a review here[/url]

From all of us at C2 Game Studio and TinyBuild, thank you for your continued support. We look forward to seeing you wield the Blade of the Monolith with newfound power and precision!

[b]— The C2 Game Studio Team[/b]

----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

notes.title: Devlog #1: A look at the Monolith: RotA Combat System
notes.content:
[b]Welcome to an exciting update on Monolith: Requiem of the Ancients development! [/b]Today, we're diving deep into the heart of the game - its combat system 

[h2]Drawing Inspiration from Legends[/h2]

Inspired by beloved classics like Devil May Cry, Bayonetta, Nier Automata, and God of War, we've crafted a combat experience that's both thrilling and accessible - we want players to feel like true powerhouses, effortlessly dispatching foes with a blend of skill and style. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44358956/200584e3ffe03e84cdd04741b84564ca6ed2e8d4.png[/img]

We've crafted the combat experience to be intuitive, allowing players to feel fully immersed in the character of Astor. Our focus on maintaining momentum ensures that each encounter feels visceral and dynamic, enhancing the overall satisfaction of engaging in combat within the game. After mastering the fundamentals, combat in Monolith: Requiem of the Ancients flows seamlessly. 

[h2]Accessibility with Depth[/h2]

One of our primary goals with Monolith's combat system was to make it accessible to newcomers while still offering depth for seasoned gamers. We've achieved this by designing combat to make it easy to keep combos going, swiftly changing from target to target, where you are provided with plenty of offensive and defensive options. Whether you're a newcomer to the genre or a veteran, we think there's something for everyone to enjoy.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44358956/b869a700688c5fbde77d2b73c639ed755dbac653.png[/img]

For those of you who want to really explore the combat system, you’ll find you have an awful lot of options to choose from when dispatching your enemy. Different enemies will have different weaknesses - for example, you can use blunt weapons to destroy an enemy's shield or a strong air attack to knock a flying enemy to the ground. If you successfully combine moves together into a combo, you will get the opportunity to perform a Runic Finisher, a powerful attack which will change depending on your equipped weapon.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44358956/0a9a04c302ce42ad63b0c7ee6fa09823f92fc12a.png[/img]

Runic constructs provide an extra layer of personalization and strategy, these are abilities that you equip and enter a cooldown when used. You can summon companions, decoys, shields and even powerful AOE attacks!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44358956/5bfaa60f06ffa7b6a1062313c80749726cfdb686.png[/img]

Our combat system is all about providing choices for the players and allowing them to experience the fight as they wish. New players will stick to the basics, but experienced players will have the tools to express themselves and dispatch enemies in a deadly and efficient dance of slashes, crushes, blasts and summons. 

[h2]Weapons and Abilities[/h2]

The default weapon - a sword,  is acquired very early on in the tutorial. As the game progresses you’ll collect resources that allow you to unlock skills, including combos and finishers.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44358956/8bcbe31bd06d2cec6f01a90bd6871ed87a96207c.png[/img]

Throughout the game, you’ll discover three more types of weapons: a pair of Gauntlets, a Spear, a Hammer and a ranged attack. You’ll also unlock a power summon skill called constructs which will allow you to bring forth tornados, minions, robots and more as you progress through the game. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44358956/66d61702c58f9ee624564aeb597562f141469bfa.png[/img]

In combat, the player can simultaneously use weapon attacks, ranged attacks and summoning constructs. Both weapon attacks and ranged attacks will have light, heavy and charged attacks, which, when combined, can form powerful combos. These combos will allow you to activate Runic Finishers.

[h2]Epic Boss Battles[/h2]

Let’s be real here, what would a game like this be without epic boss battles? In Monolith, you will face off against 10 formidable bosses, each with their own distinct abilities and combat styles. These encounters will test your skills like never before, requiring quick reflexes, strategic thinking, and mastery of your chosen weapons and abilities.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44358956/64f23fcb0ad6b9dcae39a4104cd705080bdd48b2.png[/img]

[h2]Challenges Await[/h2]

The challenges don't end with boss battles. Players can also tackle a series of special challenges accessed through portals scattered throughout the game world. From facing waves of minions to rematches with bosses, these challenges offer additional opportunities for players to hone their combat prowess and earn valuable rewards. And for those looking for an extra challenge we offer a hard difficulty level and a ‘new game +’ feature.

Before we sign off, w[b]e have an exciting announcement to share![/b] We're currently in the process of rebranding Monolith: Requiem of the Ancients. Stay tuned for more news and updates in the near future!

That's all for now! Thanks for tuning in to this Devlog update on Monolith: Requiem of the Ancients. Until next time, keep honing your combat skills and prepare for the adventure of a lifetime!

notes.title: Monolith: RotA Demo Patch Notes
notes.content:
[img]https://i.ibb.co/mCj4sPj/r54-Vc-LO-1536x864.jpg[/img]

[i]Our demo for Monolith: Requiem of the Ancients is live and ready for download until October 16th. We’re so excited to share it with you, and can’t wait to hear what you think![/i]

[b][h3]October 13th Patch Notes:[/h3][/b]
[b]Features:[/b]
[list]
[*] Input Remapping
[*] Camera Sensitivity Settings[/list]
[b]Localization In All Languages:[/b]
[list]
[*] Spanish – Latin America
[*] French
[*] German
[*] Japanese
[*] Korean
[*] Portuguese – Brazil
[*] Russian
[*] Simplified Chinese
[*] Traditional Chinese[/list]
[b]Adjustments:[/b]
[list]
[*] General UI/HUD improvements
[*] Auto dash changes to manual dash with RT or Shift Keyboard[/list]
[b]Bug Fixes:[/b]
[list]
[*] Players can now interact with a ‘Button’ to open the first ‘Gate’ before killing the enemies.
[*] ‘Zan’ no longer gets stuck on the stairs when investigating the room with ‘Astor’.
[*] All inputs will no longer be lost when interacting with the portrait while talking to ‘Zan’ in the ‘Temple of Soma’.
[*] ‘Purple Crystal’ will now respawn after loading an autosave where the player has already destroyed it at the ‘Temple of Soma’
[*] ‘Resolution Scale’ is now translated into some languages in the ‘Graphics’ menu.
[*] ‘Runic Shield’ tutorial can now be completed when reloading an autosave without finishing it at the ‘Temple of Soma’.
[*] Enemies will now spawn when reloading a save file without killing them in the wing entrance at the ‘Temple of Soma’.
[*] ‘Astor’ can now talk with ‘Zan’ in the portrait room when going there for the first time at the ‘Temple of Soma’.
[*] ‘Crystal’ can now be interacted with when reloading an autosave in the end of the ‘Religion Wing’ at the ‘Temple of Soma’.
[*] ‘Crystal’ can now be interacted with when reloading a manual save file after it is already activated in the ‘Main Chamber’ at the ‘Temple of Soma’.
[*] ‘Pickup’ is now translated into any language besides ‘English’ when interacting with the ‘Shard Upgrade’.
[*] ‘Apply’ typo has been fixed in the ‘Graphics’ menu when the game’s language is set to ‘Portuguese’.[/list]

notes.title: Monolith: Requiem of the Ancients Joins Steam Next Fest!
notes.content:
[previewyoutube=5M9CkuNnD2A;full][/previewyoutube]
[i]Monolith: Requiem of the Ancients is a highly-stylized, action-RPG set within the vibrant, mystical world of Gliese. It will release on PC, PlayStation 4|5, Xbox One, Xbox Series S|X & Nintendo Switch in early 2024.[/i]

The fate of Gliese rests on your shoulders, are you ready to become the savior this world needs?

NextFest is here!

[b][h3]We're excited to announce that our demo will be available to the public throughout the entirety of Steam Next Fest, until Oct. 16th![/h3][/b]
In the demo, your journey begins as Astor, who is right at the beginning of their epic adventure!

Astor’s search for ancient secrets leads them to the Temple of Soma, a derelict structure ripe for exploration. Will you unearth the answers you seek, or will the path be fraught with peril?

Becoming the savior of the planet is a formidable undertaking, and at this early chapter in Astor’s journey, they have much to learn. A tutorial will introduce you to the fundamentals of combat, setting the stage for the challenges that lie ahead. As you progress deeper into the game, mastering these techniques becomes paramount for survival.

Nevertheless, the journey offers opportunities for growth!

Throughout the demo, you can acquire additional skills and upgrades, gradually enhancing Astor’s capabilities. Most importantly, you’ll unlock a major ability – the Runic Blast. This skill allows you to summon a surge of arcane energy with a multitude of practical uses. Whether as a ranged attack, a means to unseal doors, or even a tool to interact with mechanisms, the Runic Blast will become an invaluable asset in your quest for answers and glory.

An epic tale of good and evil is in the midst of unfolding…

Rise, young hero. The fate of a world awaits.

[b]Notes & Known Issues:[/b]

[list]
[*] The demo is only available in English, but the full game will support French, German, Spanish – Spain, Japanese, Korean, Portuguese – Brazil, Russian, Simplified Chinese, Spanish – Latin America & Traditional Chinese for interface & subtitles.

[*] Although the demo is pretty solid overall, we’re still tidying up and fixing bugs. It is a work-in-progress and is not representative of the final product.

[*] We’re still applying tweaks to balance gameplay, so some elements may feel a bit too easy or too hard at times right now. Let us know how it feels to you!

[*] Control remapping is planned, but still WIP in this build.

[*] If you experience issues with your gamepad, please try turning off Steam Input. If you continue to experience trouble, please join us on Discord for additional troubleshooting.
[/list]

[b]Please Note:[/b]

[i]If you need help identifying your PlayStation button mapping from Xbox defaults or setting up your Steam Deck…

We have you covered in our Discord with step by step instructions and infographics![/i]

[url=https://discord.gg/monolithrota]Join Us On Discord[/url]

[b]Wishlist Monolith: Requiem of the Ancients today![/b]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1989320/Monolith_Requiem_of_the_Ancients/
